newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Forint ends firmer vs dlr, BCE yen futures drop.
newsitem.headline: Forint ends firmer vs dlr, BCE yen futures drop.

text.p: The Hungarian forint closed firmer against the dollar on Monday on the back of the strengthening mark, dealers said.
"The forint followed the mark's firming against the dollar," said Balazs Benczedi of WestLB Hungaria.
The forint finished at 155.50/55 against the U.S. unit compared with its opening of 155:78/80 and also closed most of the 20 pips gaps that separated it from the central bank's bid in morning trade.
On the Budapest Commodity Exchange (BCE) yen futures were the main movers, dropping for all maturities.
Italian lira and Swiss franc futures were the most actively traded, accounting for two-thirds of a total 5.85 billion forints turnover.
Dollar, Ecu and lira futures ended mixed, while sterling futures rose for three maturities.
